# Security Policy

The detailed security boundary and disclosure guidance is maintained in
[SECURITY.adoc](../SECURITY.adoc). Please report suspected vulnerabilities
privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/hyperpolymath/phantom-metal-taste/security/advisories/new);
do not post exploit details or private data in public issues.
